description: Tetherplane native connection profile. Public endpoints and requirements only; no secrets, tokens, or private identifiers.

device_transport.note: Verified from the live Leno launch configuration and the Vaulter tailnet serve mapping (:10000 proxies to the relay). The controlled computer needs no inbound port but must be joined to the same tailnet. No other device path is supported.

chatgpt_use.note: Using ChatGPT on another computer reuses the one existing plugin connection for the account/workspace. No new app, OAuth client, or pairing is needed.

native_connection.note: Both are public OAuth clients (token_endpoint_auth_method none, PKCE S256) already registered at the issuer. Reuse the existing connection; never register a client per computer.

add_controlled_computer.note: Each controlled computer is installed and paired once with its own locally generated device credential. Never copy a credential between computers.

policy_defaults.authority: local device Policy Broker; the relay never overrides a local denial
